asr_execution_identity.binding: run_identity_sha256 over the full canonical serialization; strict equality on resume — no partial-field acceptance
asr_execution_identity.scientific_vs_execution: absolute paths / machine facts live in execution_provenance and are EXCLUDED from the scientific content hash (machine moves preserve scientific semantics)

scoring_identity.policy: a changed scorer => new scoring identity; appending rows of a different scoring identity to an existing output is refused

physical_execution_receipt: gpu lifecycle receipt (gpu_execution VERIFIED, BDF, session pid/starttime) held by the caller (GPU lock owner); the ASR engine receipt embeds run_identity

receipt_integrity.per_receipt: transcript_receipt_sha256 = sha256(canonical receipt minus the hash field); RECOMPUTED on every audit (tamper => FAIL)
receipt_integrity.exactly_expected_repeats: both fewer and extra are rejected
receipt_integrity.manifest_binding: id must exist; declared audio hash must match; duplicate manifest ids fail closed
receipt_integrity.jsonl_corruption: torn TAIL repairable via atomic quarantine; MID-FILE corruption fails closed (never silently dropped)

resume_semantics.reusable: full identity + audio + receipt-hash + exact repeat count + status ok
resume_semantics.incomplete: atomically superseded to .superseded-<ts> and re-run (never a duplicate complete id in the final view)
resume_semantics.refused: rejected receipts / duplicates / mid-file corruption / tampered hashes (operator starts a NEW out path; nothing silently deleted)
resume_semantics.legacy_receipts: HISTORICAL_RECEIPT_VALID_IDENTITY_PARTIAL — analysis-valid, never strict-reusable; historical 8.4488% arm keeps analysis validity under this label

diagnostic_modes.--allow-partial: permits incomplete manifest coverage AND absent audio files; summary records partial=true and audio_file_verification — never enters an official scoreboard

scorer_audio_binding: verify_audio_files(): actual file hashes recomputed when files exist (declared-hash-only comparison closed); absent files fail closed without --allow-partial
